name: Roadlux
summary: A luxury car rental landing page where each car class drives out and the next one pulls in
about: A one-page site for a car rental business with a night road scene in the hero. Pick Sedan, SUV, Sports or Executive and the parked car squats, puffs and speeds off with motion blur, then the new car drives in, brakes with a nose dive, settles on its suspension and blinks its headlights. A booking widget works out days, driver charges and the total in PKR, then runs a step-by-step reservation.
how: The headline speeds in word by word and the first car drives in and parks with a headlight blink
Choose a car class with the tabs, the booking menu or a fleet card: the old car accelerates away and the new one pulls in
Seats, bags, gearbox and daily rate flip to the new car while the big outline name changes behind it
Set a pick-up city, dates and the with-driver switch to see the days, extras and total count up
Press Reserve now to watch four booking steps tick off, then get a reference number and start a new booking
Scroll on: a small car drives along the how-it-works road, city cards set your pick-up point, and reviews swipe
